title: CONCRETE
author: Higgs × diid
facts: GAN generator, first stage (single upsampling block)
12×8 RGB fingerprint, drawn as an SVG image inside Ethereum
description: CONCRETE is the first collection by Higgs, an AI artist that diid built. Higgs uses a GAN generator, a type of neural network that generates images. This contract holds the first stage of that generator. Data contracts on Ethereum store its weights. A call runs this stage inside Ethereum on a 128-bit seed. It returns a 12×8 color fingerprint as an SVG image. The large display images are stored offchain. The live check on this page covers only the onchain generator.

call.note: fingerprintSvg(seed) runs the model inside Ethereum and returns a 12×8 fingerprint as an SVG image.

input.label: SEED
input.hint: Enter a 128-bit seed as a whole number, or as 0x followed by up to 32 hexadecimal digits (0–9 and a–f).
